intent: A four-step, dark, monochrome onboarding pager for a focus app where a swipe moves one day forward through a moonlit greyscale landscape: the light, the sun and moon and the shadows change per step, a grove grows in the one accent colour, and every step's copy, chip and figures choreograph in.

apis: Animated (one pos value in pages drives the scene; one 0-1 timeline per step drives its entrance)
stack.web: react-native-web compatible; JS driver on web, native driver elsewhere; entrance blur via CSS filter on web, a 0.98 to 1 scale on native

layout.sky: full-bleed; one 3-stop LinearGradient (0 / 0.5 / 0.86) per step, stacked, layer i opacity clamp(pos - (i - 1))
layout.topBar: top 54pt, 44pt tall; dark-glass Back circle (40pt) left, centred accent leaf mark + 'grove' wordmark, dark-glass Skip pill right
layout.scene: far ridge 146pt above the card, middle hills 100pt, meadow 56pt (118/82/46 compact)
layout.chips: one auto-width glass chip per step (max 300pt), 84 or 132pt above the horizon, right on steps 1-2, left on 3-4
layout.card: near-black glass, 12pt inset from sides and bottom, 336pt tall (304 compact), radius 32; progress + clock row, copy area, 56pt pill button

clock.behaviour: winds up from 00:00 on first view, then tweens with the drag

color.approach: monochrome first, dark first: one true-neutral grey family; the single accent is reserved for the grove and the final action
color.accent: prop, default #8BE0A4: trees, brand mark, '+1' badge, best day bar, last-step button, halo, planting leaves and ring
color.bodies: sun: 460pt white radial glow, 21pt disc #FFFFFF to #E6E6E6; moon: 300pt glow, 17pt disc #F7F7F7 to #BDBDBD with 5 craters
color.glass: BlurView dark tint (60 card, 30 chips); wash rgba(30,30,30,0.66) to rgba(10,10,10,0.8) on the card; 10% white hairline; inset 0 1px 0 white 16% top, dark inset bottom
color.button: white pill #FAFAFA to #D6D6D6 with #0A0A0A text; crossfades to the accent (+30% white, accent, -14% black) across the last 0.6 page
color.grain: 96pt SVG pattern of 240 1pt dots, white 5% and black 14%

motion.drag: 1:1; rubber band (1 - 1/(o*0.55 + 1)) * 0.6 pages past the ends; release projects pos + v*0.22s, moves at most one page, spring stiffness 320 damping 30 with release velocity
motion.skyBodies: sun and moon interpolate x/y per step with a 26pt lifted midpoint (an arc); clamped below the top bar
motion.light: key light = higher of sun and moon (moon 70%); sets crest-rim brightness, tree shadow darkness and shadow direction per step
motion.trees: 13 SVG trees grow from their foot as pos nears their page (page - 0.75 to page - 0.05)
motion.firstView: 760ms: scene up out of black, hills rise 10/18/28pt, bodies 24pt, brand blurs in, card glass fades and rises 28pt (transform dropped once landed), clock winds up from 00:00, dots arrive last one by one
motion.stepEntrance: 720ms per step, every time it becomes current: kicker 0-50%, title 7-57%, body 14-64%, chip 22-70%, figure 34-84%, data 42-100%, badge 68-100%; each fades, rises 8-14pt and clears a 4-7pt blur
motion.figures: breath ring draws along its path; glyphs draw (dashoffset 64 to 0); week bars grow from the baseline left to right; numbers count up in tabular numerals and settle from a 3pt blur; '+1' pops with one overshoot
motion.replay: a step's timeline resets only once it is a full page off screen; returning replays the full entrance
motion.progress: dots built from caps plus a scaleX bar; widths 7/26/7pt per page so the pill stretches and passes along
motion.buttons: Continue/Back 560ms ease-in-out (0.65,0,0.35,1); Skip 760ms through every sky
motion.ambient: only the breath dot breathes (0.7 to 1.15, 2.4s) while its step is showing
motion.press: scale 0.97 over 90ms, spring back stiffness 420 damping 22
motion.finish: final tree springs (200/17) behind an accent glow with blossoms; 14 leaves burst in a 168 degree fan over 1.1s with an accent ring and halo; label swaps to a drawn check + 'Planted. See you at 7:30'; onFinish at 1.1s
motion.reducedMotion: no parallax (whole grove in one window at 78%), 150ms fades for pages and entrances, numbers set instantly, no breathing or burst

responsive.height: compact layout under 760pt (card 304pt, title 28pt); sun and moon clamp below the top bar; never hard-codes the device height

accessibility: Back, Skip and the main button have accessibilityRole button, labels and state; main button disabled once planted
copy area is adjustable, labelled with the current title and body, value 'Step n of 4', increment/decrement actions page
count-ups expose their final value as the accessibility label
decorative SVG sits inside aria-hidden wrappers

steps: Start small: Two quiet minutes still count. (05:40, chip 2:00 Morning breath)
Grow something: Every session plants a tree. (08:20, chip Deep work, 25 min, +1)
Look back: Watch the week take shape. (18:40, chip 14 trees this week, 7 bars)
Begin: Plant your first tree. (21:30, chip Tomorrow, 7:30)

avoid: any colour beyond the one accent: tinted skies, coloured washes, rainbow chips
Lottie, images, emoji or icon packs
pagination that jumps instead of morphing
animating width or layout during the drag
parallax layer edges showing during overscroll
a transform left on, or a fade applied to, an ancestor of a BlurView
text or numbers that pop in unanimated
confetti or anything that bounces more than once
